title: Recovery 1.4 - which J29 hole is the chip's TX (ohms)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: Ohms from J29 hole 1 and hole 2 to U1 pins 55 and 57 (count along the top edge from pin 49, the rightmost toe). A series resistor sits in each path, so a few hundred ohms is a hit. The hole on pin 55 is the chip's TX.

callouts.label: J29 hole 1 (dot end)
callouts.note: The bottom hole; the pin-1 dot is printed left of it. TP29's net (beeper, J-112). Red lead here first.

callouts.label: J29 hole 2
callouts.note: The middle hole. TP28's net (beeper, J-112). Red lead here second.

callouts.label: J29 hole 3, GND
callouts.note: The top hole. GND (J-112). Not used in this step.

callouts.label: TP28, on hole 2's net
callouts.note: Rings to J29 hole 2 (beeper, J-112). Its top edge runs into a stitching gap.

callouts.label: series resistors
callouts.note: Two resistors between J29 and TP28/TP29; which label is which is partly in a stitching gap. They put a few hundred ohms (expected) into each J29-to-U1 path.

callouts.label: U1 pin 49
callouts.note: Top edge, counted right to left from pin 49, the rightmost toe.

callouts.label: U1 pin 50
callouts.note: Top edge, counted right to left from pin 49, the rightmost toe.

callouts.label: U1 pin 51
callouts.note: Top edge, counted right to left from pin 49, the rightmost toe.

callouts.label: U1 pin 52
callouts.note: Top edge, counted right to left from pin 49, the rightmost toe.

callouts.label: U1 pin 53
callouts.note: Top edge, counted right to left from pin 49, the rightmost toe.

callouts.label: U1 pin 54
callouts.note: Top edge, counted right to left from pin 49, the rightmost toe.

callouts.label: U1 pin 55, UART0 TX
callouts.note: GPIO1, muxable as UART0_TX (SWAS035C). Seventh toe from the right (pin 49).

callouts.label: U1 pin 56
callouts.note: Top edge, counted right to left from pin 49, the rightmost toe.

callouts.label: U1 pin 57, UART0 RX
callouts.note: GPIO2, muxable as UART0_RX (SWAS035C). Ninth toe from the right (pin 49).

callouts.label: U1 pin 58
callouts.note: Top edge, counted right to left from pin 49, the rightmost toe.

terminals.label: Meter red lead: J29 hole 1, then hole 2
Meter black lead: U1 pin 55, then pin 57
